[[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], owned a modified '''''Diamond''-class cruiser'''. It was one of the forty [[Diamond-class cruiser/Legends|''Diamond''-class cruisers]] which visited the [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid factories]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to restock their [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] just prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. Shu Mai attended a meeting of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Separatist Council/Legends|council]] on Geonosis, and escaped the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on the same ship, alongside thirty-five other ''Diamond''-class [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]].<ref name="S&V 77 Directory" />
